answer: SELECT (donovan.overall_rating - bowery.overall_rating) * 100.0 / donovan.overall_rating AS pct_higher FROM (SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') AS donovan, (SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') AS bowery;
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS diff;
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC LIMIT 4;
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT MIN(pa.date) FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant' AND pa.crossing = (SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing) FROM Player_Attributes pa2 JOIN Player p2 ON p2.player_api_id = pa2.player_api_id WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant');

SELECT (b.max_rating - p.max_rating) * 100.0 / p.max_rating AS pct_higher FROM (SELECT MAX(pa.overall_rating) AS max_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player pl ON pl.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pl.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk') b, (SELECT MAX(pa.overall_rating) AS max_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player pl ON pl.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pl.player_name = 'Paulin Puel') p;
note: Player_Attributes holds many dated rows per player and the question gives no date, so each player's peak overall_rating (MAX) is used as their representative value.

answer: SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND ta.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';
SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';
SELECT player_name FROM (SELECT player_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS rnk FROM Player) WHERE rnk = 1;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE substr(birthday,1,4) = '1970' AND substr(birthday,6,2) = '10';
